lessons.title: Freiburg’s leap into Europe
lessons.subtitle: A second Bundesliga season became an unexpected springboard to Europe.

story.title: A remarkable second season
story.body: After securing Bundesliga survival in 1994, Freiburg finished third the following year. The club’s early top-flight campaign quickly became a European breakthrough.

story.body: The 1994/95 finish was only three points behind champions Borussia Dortmund and earned Freiburg its first European competition place.
